summary: Hiking party possibly near Pawnee Lake with one individual showing possible altitude sickness; poor cell service left details unclear. Flight For Life flew night-vision recon, located light signals, and landed near the subject at first light Saturday; the flight crew assessed HAPE with the subject deteriorating, and he was flown to St. Anthony's Hospital in Denver by 07:00. GCSAR never entered the field.
location: Pawnee Lake area, Indian Peaks Wilderness (~7.5 mi from Monarch Lake)
notes: Date approximate: Notified Friday night 2021-07-23; evac completed morning of 2021-07-24. Team counts it as a life saved.
